title: Bone marrow B cell transcriptomic profile in humanized NSG mice injected with KU55933
description: RNA Sequencing was performed on RNA extracted from human bone marrow B cells from NSG humanized mice that had been transplanted with human hematopoietic stem cells and then injected or not with the ATM inhibitor KU55933. Overall design: RNA was extracted from batch sorted human CD45+CD19+CD10+IgM+ bone marrow B cells isolated from humanized NSG injected or not with ATM inhibitor KU55933
